wa_little_dishman_30_feet_of_fury.notes: access stays null (HELD). Little Dishman's only placement is Mountain Project's coordinate and approach text (never evidence). The Spokane County parcel layer at that point is a Spokane County 'Park' parcel (45191.9107), and the gully east of the water tower is too (45191.9124), but the water tower itself and the parcels at the north end are Hutchinson Irrigation District No. 16 (the private owner of most of main Dishman, per the WCC), with Dishman Hills Natural Area Assn. parcels beside them. No official page (DNR NRCA page, Conservancy recreation page) mentions climbing, Little Dishman, the Appleway gate or its parking; the Spokane County Dishman Hills page answered 403. Manager unclear, so no object is built. pitches 1 is kept: one 25-30 ft line to one anchor (implied, not stated, so not locked). discipline not locked (MP alone).
